about_the_game:
Overview:

Lost&Found: The Demo is about the story of Olivia Sasaki.

Olivia's life has always been easy. Growing up in a challenging environment has made her hesitant to reach out to new people and build trust with others, so most of her life she's looked out for herself.

However, all that's changing now. This 16-year-old is moving from America to Japan to live with her older brother Jacob and hopefully get a fresh new start.

Although she has visited Japan many times to see her ojii-chan (grandfather), it's still a different place with new challenges she must overcome.

What’s Included in the Demo:

  • 🏫 Story before the demo starts: The game starts during Olivia's first day of school. She tries to go unnoticed and keep to herself out of other people's business. Unfortunately, things take a turn for the worst during lunch when she trips, spilling her food all over the cafeteria floor and her new uniform. Not a single soul offered a hand (Their hands were busy taking pictures and going to social media about it) not a single soul except, Chiharu. Chiharu helps her up and comforts her. After the school day she drags Olivia out to meet her group of friends.

  • 👥 Plenty of people to interact with: We have a wide variety of characters to meet during your game time. Characters such as:

    • Chiharu, the ever-supportive friend with an infectious energy that draws people in.

    • Yukina, the girl who's effortlessly cool no matter what she does with lots of great ideas.

    • Niko, Yukina's twin brother. Even though she shines a bit brighter he still gets plenty of screen time with his fun sense of humor and passion for making others crack a smile and let out a giggle.

    • Junichiro stands out as a charming heartthrob with an effortlessly magnetic personality and has a lot of curiosity about other places in the world, especially America. Girls often flock around him, but his heart belongs to the intelligent, graceful Keisuke.

    • Keisuke, who is quiet at first has a lot to say if you have the same interests. Once you get her started on her favorite book or subject in school, it can be hard to stop her.

    • Minoru, who's tough exterior may lead one to think he's aloof or unkind, yet beneath that façade lies a genuinely caring person willing to lead a hand to those in need.

  • 🗣️ Dialogue choices that let's the player connect better with other characters 

  • 🖱️ Exploration via point-and-click mechanics in select scenes. Hidden objects can be found in Olivia’s environment—some open extra dialogue or bonus content.

  • 💻 Interactive computer interface on the main menu, allowing email checks and simple folder browsing.

  • 🧭 Your choices matter—they slightly alter the way the story ends but not as much in the demo as it WILL make a BIG difference in the full game.

  • ⏱️ Estimated playtime: 25–55 minutes depending on curiosity and interaction.

What’s not included yet:

  • Full story arcs for supporting characters

  • Deeper relationship-building mechanics

  • Advanced item usage or puzzle-solving

  • Lore

name: Lost&Found: The Demo
short_description: You play as Olivia Sasaki, a new student who moved to Japan all the way from America. Meet new friends and search for lost things, you might just end up finding yourself along the way!
